name: VA-CABLE-USB3-xxm-HF
family: VA Imaging active high-flex USB 3.0 cables

sources.title: VA-CABLE-USB3-xxm-HF datasheet: USB 3.0 Cable Type A To Micro-B with Screw Lock, active high flex cable series (VA Imaging, 3 pages)
sources.covers: connectors, cable diameter, bend radius dynamic and static, tensile and crush strength, temperature, power, the bending test, part numbers and lengths, construction

note: An active optical USB 3.0 cable (optical transceivers at each end, OM1 fibre plus copper power pairs, Kevlar strength member, black TPU jacket): USB3.0 Standard-A plug at the host, USB3.0 Micro-B plug with locking screws at the device. Stated: cable diameter 4.8 mm (drawing: 4.80 +/- 0.2 mm); bend radius "50mm (dynamic)" and "20mm (static)"; bending test at a 50 mm radius, 1000 mm stroke, 80 cycles/min, 25 C, ">20million cycles" without bit errors (flex_cycles 20000000 is that lower bound); tensile strength 150 N long term, 300 N short term; operating temperature -10 to +50 C; host-side input 4.75-5.25 V, 200 mA, 0.94 W maximum. Lengths: 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 34 and 50 m. Being active, the cable has a host and a device end. Revision and date of the datasheet are not printed on it.

connectors: USB 3.0 Micro-B plug with locking screws (device)
